# Enable Recording and Replay Audit

## Goal

Put remote browsing access for specified groups into recording mode and replay historical operations in the backend.

## Prerequisites

- The deployed version supports the full feature set, and the installation package must be the Enterprise Edition.
- The administrator has the **View Recording and Replay** permission.
- Access records have already been generated.

## Enable Recording

Go to:

```text
Group Management > Group List
```

Click **Privileges** to open the group privilege settings page, as shown in @fig-group-privileges-replay. Select **Recording and Replay**, then save.

![Sa2web group recording and replay](/images/group-privileges-replay.png){#fig-group-privileges-replay}

After that, users in the group enter recording mode while browsing, as shown in @fig-replay-record.

![Sa2web frontend recording page](/images/replay-record.png){#fig-replay-record}

During recording, a red line appears at the top of the page to remind the user that the current access is being recorded.

## View Replay

Go to:

```text
User Management > User List
User Management > Admin List
```

Find the target user and click the "![](/images/replay.png){width=30px}" button to enter the replay page, as shown in @fig-replay-page.

![Sa2web replay page](/images/replay-page.png){#fig-replay-page}

1. Select an access record.
2. Use play, pause, and progress controls to review it.
3. If you need to copy content from the replay page, click the "![](/images/unlock-record-copy.png){width=30px}" button. You can then copy content from the replay page.

## Suitable Scenarios

- Employee operation audit.
- Training review.
- Troubleshooting.
- Business handover.
- Review of high-risk backends.

## Acceptance Checklist

- [ ] Recording is enabled for the target group.
- [ ] New access creates records.
- [ ] The replay page opens.
- [ ] Playback and progress controls work normally.
- [ ] Unauthorized administrators cannot view recordings.
